author: kk84
quote:
For the first time in so many years FIFA22 on newgen is finally a real football game. Much more realistic and fluid. Less ping pong, less dribbling and fast running all the time. Now you actually have to think football, much better passing system, also through balls and balls in the air are much better, So EA need to get praise for finally making gameplay in the right direction. Also applaus for the graphics. Really good this year on ps5.
A wish for the future is less focus on ultimate, i know its money and cash for them but have been the problem with the game for so many years.
Only bad thing this year is manager mode. Some love create your own club but its just unrealistic can already make my own team in ultimate. i dont need that.
I want much more focus on career mode in the future. Just look at Football Manager and some of the thinks from Nba2k.

To football fans out there FIFA22 on ps5 is the real deal finally especially on the pitch.

author: kk84
quote: A masterpiece! Call of duty is back again like in the old days! Graphics, gameplay, campaign is great i want more more more!

author: kk84
quote:
I have played FIFA for many years. But im so tired of EA. Its almost the same game as FIFA19,18,etc. The gameplay is too arcady and not realistic at all. It actually feels worse than last year in some ways. the animations, the whole build up play is a mess and runs from teammates feels akward. I also play PES and did for 3 years now beside FIFA. And after been playing PES20, im so dissapointed to see how little FIFA have improved compared to PES, and seen PES gameplay is just not only on another level, but a whole other dimenssion! Its much more realistic, animations, passing, shooting, the players feel like real life, the whole gameplay is just so much more fluid and like real life. I do like FIFAs graphics and sound, but again it often looks like a cartoon and not like real life. Im tired of Ultimate money mode ruin the other things in FIFA because this is just a cash grap game now! I normally love career mode, but now there are so many bugs in the game and the mode that its almost not playable. This is horrible and so bad. Im tired of unrealistic gameplay, bugs.
Almost nothing new, almost nothing improved. I will stick with PES 2020 until they do something about it!

quote:

Clearly game of the year without any doubts!

author: kk84
quote: I had really big hopes for this but i dont think its worth the price. The game is a beauty but gameplay is not that fun. the in-game activities are trivial. author: kk84
quote:
FIFA is dead to me. Its clearly they only go for the money with their ultimate fantasy crap mode for children! what has the mode to do with real football?!
The gameplay graphics career mode is just the same every year in and out!
No big innovations, just more frustrations..
It seems they cant work on anymore with this platform its just the same game every year with minor tweaks.
The gameplay has nothing to do with real football, yes they have the license witch is great but the gameplay in PES is miles ahead with a bright future with a new system going on.
Fifa is just getting worse and worse every year.
They have to start all over with the gameplay system and innovate if they really do care about their fans!

author: kk84
quote:
